description: NORCE Research AS is one of Norway's largest independent research institutes, created through the merger of several regional university-owned institutes. Primarily owned by major Norwegian universities - including the University of Bergen, University of Stavanger, University of Agder, and University of Troms{\o} - it operates across multiple locations nationwide. The organisation employs around 800 people and delivers applied and basic research across key sectors such as energy, climate, environment, health, technology, and social sciences. Through partnerships with both public institutions and private industry, NORCE focuses on driving sustainable innovation and solving complex societal challenges.
